readiness.eligibleRowsDefinition: Eligible means valid and without identified duplicates for a draft-only projection of mapped columns. It does not mean all source fields can be retained or that a write import is authorized.
blockers: No database columns exist for hospital ownership type, hospital email, or nodal officer name.
The source ID has no dedicated unique field; public_source_reference is only a non-unique text carrier.

constraints.definition: CHECK (((expires_at IS NULL) OR (last_verified_at IS NULL) OR (expires_at >= last_verified_at)))
FOREIGN KEY (hospital_id) REFERENCES hospitals(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (verified_by_user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

indexes.indexdef: CREATE INDEX hospital_verification_records_hospital_history_idx ON public.hospital_verification_records USING btree (hospital_id, created_at DESC)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX hospital_verification_records_one_current_idx ON public.hospital_verification_records USING btree (hospital_id) WHERE is_current
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX hospital_verification_records_pkey ON public.hospital_verification_records USING btree (id)
CREATE INDEX hospital_verification_records_status_idx ON public.hospital_verification_records USING btree (status, last_verified_at DESC)
CREATE INDEX hospital_verification_records_verified_location_gix ON public.hospital_verification_records USING gist (verified_location)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX hospitals_pkey ON public.hospitals USING btree (id)
CREATE INDEX hospitals_public_city_listing_idx ON public.hospitals USING btree (lower(public_city), public_listing_status) WHERE (public_city IS NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX hospitals_public_listing_name_idx ON public.hospitals USING btree (lower(public_name)) WHERE (public_listing_status = 'published'::hospital_listing_status)
CREATE INDEX hospitals_public_location_gix ON public.hospitals USING gist (public_location)

sourceIdentifier.recommendation: Use public_source_reference only as a temporary text carrier; before a future write importer, choose either a dedicated source-system/source-record-ID pair with a unique index or a dedicated provenance mapping table.

fieldMappings.mapping: direct text source identifier; no uniqueness constraint
included in source label; no dedicated source-date column

unmappedFields.reason: Public/Private describes ownership; the schema has no ownership field.
There is no hospital email column in the current schema.
There is no nodal officer column in the current schema.

fieldLimitations.reason: There is no dedicated source-date column; retain in provenance text.
public_source_reference can hold the ID, but the schema has no dedicated or unique source-ID field.

proposedDatabaseState.explanation: The enum has no unverified value. Pending plus draft is the safe representation: it is not verified and is not publicly listed.
